DocketRouter.title: DocketRouter
DocketRouter.description: A verification layer over an open legal library: check that a reporter citation exists (18M citations, answers 'found' or 'unverified', never 'nonexistent'), check whether a cited opinion actually supports a proposition, and read statutes and court rules word for word. Not a national case-law search engine — use CourtListener for that and this to verify what it found.

CourtListener.title: CourtListener
CourtListener.description: Free Law Project's legal research platform — millions of U.S. court opinions, PACER dockets, judge profiles, oral arguments, and citation verification. The source the docketx case-law datasets are sliced from.
